$comment: Parameters for the update script. Kept out of code so a run can be scoped without edits.

discovery.$comment_exclude: excludeNames drops directory entries that are not companies we want to list (YC lists itself, for instance). Round 4 (2026-09-22): St. Jude, Miltenyi Biotec and Natera are not tech companies. GovStar's HN post linked govstar.us, an unrelated design studio, and the real company's govstar.ai had an expired TLS certificate; Furtim Modus's whole site is one recruiting tagline and Track It Forward blocks every fetch — none could be described from their own words, and the schema rightly will not take a job ad instead.

seeds.$comment: Companies added by hand, for ecosystems with no reachable directory feed. Startup Estonia publishes its database through a Cloudflare-protected Dealroom portal (ecosystem.startupestonia.ee) that blocks every automated request, including robots.txt, so Estonian coverage is curated here instead. A seed is a pointer, not a claim: name and website are required and everything else is established by the refresh scan. Descriptions are each company's own meta description, read from its homepage on 2026-09-18, not written by us. Every domain was checked live the same day; Grünfin was dropped because its site now says only "Grünfin is closed".

discovery.$comment_sources: Registered but deliberately absent: 'remoteok'. Its API carries no company website field, so every record is skipped under the own-domain rule (measured: 0 of 99), and its terms require a follow link back to Remote OK from any site using the data. See scripts/update/SOURCES.md.

hnhiring.$comment: months = how many recent 'Ask HN: Who is hiring?' threads to read. remoteOnly keeps only candidates the post itself describes as remote or hybrid, which is the reason this source is here.

weworkremotely.$comment: RSS category feeds. Roughly a third of postings link the employer's own domain; the rest are skipped rather than stored with an aggregator link.

refresh.$comment: Per-run caps keep a single invocation bounded and polite.

positions.$comment: Titles matching excludePatterns are dropped. Two kinds: roles this directory does not cover (internships), and postings that are not roles at all — an 'Open Application' or 'Talent Pool' entry is an invitation to send a CV, and counting it claims a company is hiring for something specific when it is not. Matched case-insensitively as substrings, so anchored wording is used where a real title could collide.

keywordVocabulary.$comment: Detected in job titles and descriptions to populate detectedKeywords and company keywords. Left-hand side is the canonical tag; right-hand side are the surface forms matched case-insensitively as whole words.
